verdict.rationale: Factory's docs describe a dedicated `/readiness-fix` slash command that automatically fixes failing agent-readiness criteria. It is available in both the Factory App (web and desktop) and the Droid CLI, and it pairs with `/readiness-report`, which first evaluates the repository's readiness level. Missing for 10: detail on which criteria can be auto-fixed and how fixes are reviewed or applied, plus independent or hands-on corroboration beyond the vendor's own docs.
